title: At the café
subtitle: カフェで
review: Written by Claude. The Japanese, the romaji and the recordings have not been checked by a Japanese speaker. English support only: no Burmese lines were written.
intro: A customer orders at a café. Listen for what he orders and how much it costs.
steps: Press Play all with the text hidden. Who is speaking, and where are they?
Listen again, then answer the questions under the dialogue.
Tap the lines to show the text, and listen once more while reading.
Shadow it: play a line, press Pause (or the space bar), say it aloud, then Resume.
Take a role and say your lines in the pauses.

lines.kana: コーヒーをひとつください。
lines.say: コーヒーを一つください。

lines.romaji: Hotto desu ka, aisu desu ka.
lines.kana: ホットですか、アイスですか。
ホットでおねがいします。
lines.say: ホットでお願いします。

lines.kana: ケーキはいかがですか。
ありがとうございます。

questions.why: Kōhī o hitotsu kudasai... Hotto de onegaishimasu: one coffee, hot.
Iie, kekkō desu = No, thank you.

notes: ... de onegaishimasu = I'd like it ..., please.
Iie, kekkō desu = No, thank you (polite).
